name: @local/dsh-extra-plan
description: 额外规划模式（extra-plan 预设专用）：按需规划 + 三级机械锚点（路由/澄清/批准）+ anchored 引导（主会话与规划子代理）+ 规划子代理探查硬上限 + 力度继承 + save_plan 方案落盘（原子双写）+ 子代理沙箱下限 + usage 账本。Mounted by the extra-plan preset; the bundled preset-sync component distributes the preset assets to the user agent-presets root.
